thread:
Aisha (partnerships): Heads-up — we're getting 3 new SI partners next month and they want an end-to-end hands-on lab + lightweight certification. Need to align on format + who runs what.
Diego (solutions): +1. Proposed structure: 90min lab (deploy + run sample app) + 30min QA/cert quiz. We can split into infra + app tracks.
Maya (devex): I can own the lab content (guides + labs repo) if Elliot can provision the sandboxes. Need clear pass criteria.
Elliot (platform): I can spin up isolated VPC sandboxes per partner, but need a list of required GPU types, capacity, and whether they want private vs hosted models. Also list of IPs for allowlist.
Tom (sales): From GTM side partners expect a co-branded badge and a short enablement cert they can show customers. Can we issue a digital badge and add to partner portal?
Aisha (partnerships): Yes — badge + entry in partner portal. Also need a playbook for post-cert handoff to CSMs.
Diego (solutions): For pass criteria: basic checklist: 1) deploy model endpoint, 2) run 10 concurrent requests under 100ms p50 (hosted) or confirm throughput on Dedicated, 3) implement basic fallback policy, 4) run simple eval checks. Pass = all but one optional item.
Maya (devex): I'll draft the rubric. Suggest we keep the quiz <=10 questions, multiple choice + 1 config debugging question.
partners-bot: Reminder — schedule open slots available: 2026-03-27 10:00, 2026-03-30 15:00, 2026-04-02 09:00. Book via /partners-schedule.
Tom (sales): Can we do a 2-hour pilot with the first SI to refine timings? Suggest March 27 for pilot.
Elliot (platform): Confirming GPU needs: G5-style (A10G equiv) should cover demo scale. For Dedicated testing we'll use a smaller queue. Also will provide a prebuilt terraform snippet:
```
module "redwood_sandbox" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-sandboxes//modules/sandbox"
  name   = "si-<partner>-lab"
  gpus   = 1
}
```
Maya (devex): Nice. I'll add that snippet to the labs repo and include a short troubleshooting doc for common TF errors.
Aisha (partnerships): Logistics checklist I want: training slides, labs repo link, quiz, badge criteria, CSM handoff doc, calendar invite + timezone options, invoice tracking if partners take paid cert. Can each owner confirm next steps?
Diego (solutions): I'll own the deploy/run lab exercises + scoring. ETA for draft: 72 hours.
Maya (devex): I'll publish lab repo + slides. ETA: 5 days.
Elliot (platform): Sandboxes ready for the pilot on 2026-03-25. Will provide allowlist and credentials in the partners secure vault.
Tom (sales): I'll coordinate invites and partner comms. Will create a tracking row in the partner CRM.
Aisha (partnerships): Great — pilot on 2026-03-27 then. After pilot we'll iterate and aim for official run the week after. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Diego (solutions): +1, will do a dry run with Maya on 03/25.
Maya (devex): Adding README, rubrics, and quiz to repo. Link will be posted here once ready.
partners-bot: Event created: SI Lab Pilot — 2026-03-27 10:00 UTC (calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/si-lab-pilot).
Aisha (partnerships): Filing follow-up action items in Asana. If anyone needs budget approvals for extra infra let me know.
Elliot (platform): Noted. If we need Dedicated capacity for the official run, request 72h lead time.
Tom (sales): FYI, partner asked about joint press mention if they get certified quickly — we'll draft a short co-announce template but don't promise.
Aisha (partnerships): Agreed, template only. OK closing thread — will post the repo link and calendar invites once Maya/Elliot confirm.
Maya (devex): Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-labs (draft branch: si-field-readiness). Feedback welcome.
Diego (solutions): Reviewing the repo now. Quick note: add a small sample prompt set for quality checks.
Aisha (partnerships): Perfect. Closing with action owners: Diego (scenarios + scoring), Maya (repo + quiz), Elliot (sandboxes), Tom (invites + CRM), Aisha (playbook + badge). Thanks everyone :rocket:
